dogecoin.text:
It’s starting to dawn on many of us OG #crypto traders that the last two “alt seasons” were just insiders. Look at the retail volume on $ETH this week and it’s epic Google search spike. 

What if we have one or more omega seasons ahead? $DOGE mirrored 2017 $XRP almost exactly.

I appreciate that the #crypto markets are roaring back today, but when $BNB and $DOGE are catching serious bids, I have a hard time believing this is over.

$ETH and #DeFi look just fine on daily and above timeframes, but $BTC could easily retest $30k and drag us all with it.
Is it really capitulation if $DOGE is more than $0.01?

@ercwl I think we all know what we would do if someone from the future told us in 2019 that $DOGE was going to $0.50.

We would punch them in the face and tell them to stop day-drinking. 😎

Utterly shocking how well $DOGE continues to perform in this dump. I just can't see how this ends until there is a total washout of the shitcoins and scams. 

This is the free market's way of handling the things the regulators didn't want to. https://t.co/Spk4z67Cky
@WhaleTrades And then there are days when $DOGE happens
Incredible $DOGE card protector at my Aria poker game this afternoon. 🥳 https://t.co/7cOu5sUKU6

@LouisShulman Robinhood and Cash App just quote you whatever makes them the most money. If $DOGE is 0.32 on a CLOB (like Coinbase) and >51% of their volume is buying, they will mark it up and pocket the difference.

No fees are a lie. They are charging the MOST fees.

$HOOD is pathetic as a crypto play. They have a ton of baggage, their tech infra is years behind, and they have no compelling product advantages.

What’s the monetization? Most of the company’s Q2 revenue was from $DOGE spread-spoofing their customers. “No transaction fees” 🥸

Not sure why Elon is messing around with TradFi to fund a $TWTR acquisition. The man made $DOGE go to almost $1. That whole project was a dog NFT attached to an infinite waterfall of tokenized bulldart. If he formed TwitterDAO, this would be over yesterday.
If you want to know why I, a perennial memecoin hater, am trading $DOGE lately, this weekly chart should tell you everything you need to know. https://t.co/OR8UUAKu2P

My crypto trading roadmap going into the coming weeks:

Holding $BTC and $DOGE into Monday. Equity flows should finally start catching up this week, and this is usually a decent beta with the exception of the most recent divergence in tech vs crypto. $BTC should see rerating or https://t.co/Z2ScfmsxNT
